name: Light the Way / actual nonyellow charge and no yellow-only reward
printed_text:
As an additional cost to play this, you may **charge** your soul.

When this hits, if a yellow card was **charged** this way, this gets **go again**.

name: Spirit of War / actual nonyellow charge and no yellow-only reward
printed_text:
As an additional cost to play this, you may **charge** your soul.

If a yellow card was **charged** this way, whenever an attack action card hits this combat chain, create a Courage token.
